name: Control toolbox
description: Counterspells, board wipes, removal, card draw and a few big finishers in blue, white and black – everything a deck needs to say no, then win.

cards.name: Stillwater Denial
cards.rule_text: Counter target spell. If that spell was a creature spell, scry 2.

cards.name: Hush the Chant
cards.rule_text: Counter target instant or sorcery spell unless its controller pays {2}. Scry 1.

cards.name: Unspun Thread
cards.rule_text: Counter target creature spell. Create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying.

cards.name: Keeper of the Sealed Stacks
cards.rule_text:
Flash
When CARDNAME enters, counter target spell with mana value 3 or less.

cards.name: Ruling of the Silent Court
cards.rule_text: Counter target spell. You gain life equal to its mana value.
cards.flavor_text: The court does not argue. It decides.

cards.name: Hour of Clean Ash
cards.rule_text: Destroy all creatures. You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed this way.
cards.flavor_text: After the fire, only the quiet was left standing.

cards.name: Creeping Blackfog
cards.rule_text:
All creatures get -3/-3 until end of turn.
Cycling {2}

cards.name: Undertow of Ages
cards.rule_text: Return all nonland permanents to their owners' hands. Draw two cards.

cards.name: Binding Vow
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield. Scry 1.

cards.name: Sudden Gloom
cards.rule_text: Destroy target creature with mana value 3 or less. Surveil 1.

cards.name: Penance and Ash
cards.rule_text: Exile target creature or planeswalker. Its controller gains life equal to its mana value.

cards.name: Lost in Reverie
cards.rule_text:
Flash
Enchant creature an opponent controls
Enchanted creature can't attack or block.
At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 1.

cards.name: Lamplit Study
cards.rule_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
cards.flavor_text: The best answers are found after midnight.

cards.name: Bleak Accounting
cards.rule_text: You draw two cards and you lose 2 life. If a creature died this turn, draw an additional card.

cards.name: Vigil of the Still Hall
cards.rule_text: At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't attack this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Shadowpost Informant
cards.rule_text:
Flash
Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Leviathan of the Deep Archive
cards.rule_text:
Ward {4}
When CARDNAME enters, return up to two target nonland permanents your opponents control to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Seraph of the Final Hour
cards.rule_text:
Flying, vigilance, lifelink
Ward {2}
cards.flavor_text: She comes when the arguing is over.

cards.name: Gravebell Horror
cards.rule_text:
Menace
At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Velisar, the Last Word
cards.rule_text:
Flash
Vigilance
Whenever you cast an instant spell during an opponent's turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you draw a card.
